newsitem.title: CHILE: Banco Edwards sees no loss from Isacruz fall.
newsitem.headline: Banco Edwards sees no loss from Isacruz fall.

text.p: Banco de A. Edwards will see no net negative effect to its balance sheet as a consequence of the failure of private cemetery chain Isacruz, the bank's president Sergio de Castro said.

''When the process is finally over, the bank will end up with zero losses,'' he told reporters at a business conference. The bank's consumer credit unit Finandes will see a ''minimal loss'' from the collapse of Isacruz early this year.

Chilean authorities levied a 224 million peso ($533,000) penalty against Banco Edwards in July for exceeding legal limits in loans granted to Isacruz, which filed for bankruptcy protection in March with debts totalling about $160 million. Its failure sent shockwaves through the Chilean financial community.
The bank was also ordered in July to set aside $2.9 million in provisions to cover risky loans, which de Castro said the bank should be able to recover by the end of the year.
De Castro also described the bank's $23.8 million bond placement Wednesday as a success.
